# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c20 P10](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair, neat, and small girl with a straight nose, a prim mouth, and gentle hazel eyes. She wears her fine, silky, fawn-colored hair in long, smooth curls that rarely get out of order.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is remarkably quiet, well-behaved, and obedient, often described as 'prunes and prisms' in her demeanor. She is naturally faithful, industrious, and orderly, always eager to help with household chores without needing to be asked twice. Though timid and easily scared, she possesses a placid and steady nature that rarely gets ruffled.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P11](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0011), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v3 c1 P3](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0003)_

- Systematic gardening  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Reciting Sunday School lessons smoothly  <sub>[v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030)</sub>

## History

Dora Keith was born the daughter of Mary Keith and a third cousin of Marilla Cuthbert. After her father died in her infancy and her mother succumbed to a long illness, she and her twin brother Davy were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley at Green Gables. Unlike her mischievous brother, Dora quickly settled into life at Green Gables, exhibiting quiet, orderly habits and a desire to help with household tasks. She began attending Avonlea School under Anne's instruction when she turned seven. When her uncle Richard died in British Columbia, he left a trust fund for her and Davy, securing their permanent home at Green Gables under Marilla's care.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)_
